description: This file defines the RateController class, an abstract class in Spark Streaming responsible for managing stream ingestion rate based on batch completion updates and a RateEstimator.

classes.name: RateController
classes.description: An abstract class that manages the rate of message ingestion in Spark Streaming based on batch completion metrics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes execution context and rate limit atomic variable.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Handles deserialization and re-initialization of transient fields.

methods.name: computeAndPublish
methods.description: Calculates new rate limit asynchronously and publishes it.
